name: octo_health_check
description: Check that the Octo Browser API is reachable. Call this first to verify the app is running.

name: octo_list_profiles
description: List the profiles currently running on this machine, with UUID, title and ws_endpoint.

name: octo_start_profile
signature: uuid: Annotated[str, Field(description="Octo Browser profile UUID"
description:
Start a profile by UUID and return the ws_endpoint for the CDP connection.

    If the profile is already running, its current data is returned instead.

name: octo_stop_profile
signature: uuid: Annotated[str, Field(description="UUID of the profile to stop"
description: Stop a running Octo Browser profile by UUID.

name: octo_start_one_time_profile
signature: os: Annotated[ # noqa: A002 - the schema field is named "os" Literal["win", "mac", "lin", "android"], Field(description="Fingerprint OS"
description:
Create and start a one-time (temporary) profile.

    It is removed once stopped and starts faster than a regular profile, which suits scraping.

name: octo_find_profile_by_name
signature: name: Annotated[str, Field(description="Profile title to look for (e.g. '5249_US'
description:
Find a profile by title. The API matches from the beginning of the title.

    Requires OCTO_API_TOKEN.

name: octo_start_profile_by_name
signature: name: Annotated[ str, Field(description="Title of the profile to find and start (e.g. '5249_US'
description: Find a profile by title and start it (find + start in one call). Requires OCTO_API_TOKEN.

name: octo_search_profiles
signature: search: Annotated[ str | None, Field(description="Title prefix (matches from the start of the title
description: Search profiles by title prefix or tags. Several tags mean AND. Requires OCTO_API_TOKEN.

name: octo_get_profile
signature: uuid: Annotated[str, Field(description="Profile UUID"
description: Get full profile data by UUID: fingerprint, proxy, extensions, description, tags.

name: octo_get_extensions
description: List the team's browser extensions with name, version and UUID.

name: octo_delete_extensions
signature: uuids: Annotated[ list[str], Field(description="Extension UUIDs to delete (e.g. 'abc123@2.0.12'
description:
Delete team extensions by UUID.

    Extensions in use by a running profile come back once that profile stops.

name: octo_get_tags
description: List all profile tags with name, color and UUID.

name: octo_get_proxies
description: List all saved proxies with type, host, port and UUID.

name: browser_connect
signature: ws_endpoint: Annotated[ str, Field(description="CDP WebSocket endpoint (from octo_start_profile
description: Connect to a running Octo Browser profile over CDP. Call after octo_start_profile.

name: browser_disconnect
description: Disconnect from the browser (does not stop the Octo profile).

name: browser_navigate
signature: url: Annotated[str, Field(description="Target URL"
description: Navigate to a URL.

name: browser_get_url
description: Get the current page URL.

name: browser_go_back
description: Go back in browser history.

name: browser_go_forward
description: Go forward in browser history.

name: browser_reload
description: Reload the current page.

name: browser_click
signature: selector: OptionalSelector = None, x: Annotated[float | None, Field(description="X coordinate"
description: Click an element by CSS selector, or click at (x, y) coordinates.

name: browser_type
signature: text: Annotated[str, Field(description="Text to type"
description:
Type text.

    With a selector the value is filled instantly; without one the text is typed
    key by key into the focused element.

name: browser_press_key
signature: key: Annotated[str, Field(description="Key name: 'Enter', 'Tab', 'Escape', 'Backspace', ..."
description: Press a keyboard key (Enter, Tab, Escape, ArrowDown, ...).

name: browser_scroll
signature: direction: Annotated[ Literal["up", "down", "left", "right"], Field(description="Scroll direction"
description: Scroll the page, or a specific element when a selector is given.

name: browser_hover
signature: selector: Selector
description: Hover over an element (useful for dropdowns and tooltips).

name: browser_select
signature: selector: Annotated[str, Field(description="CSS selector of the select element"
description: Select an option in a <select> dropdown.

name: browser_screenshot
signature: selector: Annotated[ str | None, Field(description="CSS selector of the element (optional, else the page
description: Take a screenshot of the page or of a single element. Returns a PNG.

name: browser_get_text
signature: selector: Selector
description: Get the text content of an element.

name: browser_get_html
signature: selector: OptionalSelector = None, outer: Annotated[bool, Field(description="Include the element's own tag (outerHTML
description: Get the HTML of the page or of an element.

name: browser_get_attribute
signature: selector: Selector, attribute: Annotated[str, Field(description="Attribute name"
description: Get an attribute value from an element.

name: browser_query_selector_all
signature: selector: Annotated[str, Field(description="CSS selector"
description: Find all elements matching a selector and return their metadata.

name: browser_wait_for_selector
signature: selector: Selector, timeout: Annotated[int, Field(description="Timeout in milliseconds", ge=0
description: Wait for an element to reach a given state.

name: browser_evaluate
signature: script: Annotated[str, Field(description="JavaScript code to execute"
description: Run JavaScript on the page and return the result.

name: browser_list_tabs
description: List the open tabs with title, URL and active flag.

name: browser_switch_tab
signature: index: Annotated[int, Field(description="Tab index (zero-based
description: Switch to a tab by index.

name: browser_new_tab
signature: url: Annotated[str | None, Field(description="URL to open (optional
description: Open a new tab, optionally navigating to a URL.

name: browser_close_tab
description: Close the current tab.
